Occupying the top nine floors of the Midtown Tower in Roppongi, The Ritz-Carlton, Tokyo offers spectacular 360-degree views of the city, including Tokyo Tower and Mount Fuji on clear days. Located right next to the famous Ginza shopping district, the Conrad offers a magnificent panoramic view which includes Tokyo Bay, the city skyline, and Mt. Fuji. It has a 25-meter pool with skyline vistas and the Mizuki Spa, Michelin-starred dining featuring Asian and French cuisine, and is located in the 37-story Shiodome skyscraper next to the ancient Hamarikyu Gardens.

### The Peninsula Tokyo
A classic luxury choice. Staying here offers not only opulent rooms but also exceptional service that caters to your every need.

### Other Notable Options
- **The Prince Park Tower Tokyo** — Hot springs, 7 restaurants, and an indoor pool are all featured at this luxury hotel, with great Tokyo Tower views (9.4/10).

- **Imperial Hotel, Tokyo** — This luxury hotel includes 8 restaurants, an indoor pool, and a 24-hour gym, plus a children's pool and babysitting (9.6/10).
- **Janu Tokyo** (Roppongi) — A newer wellness-focused property near Tokyo Tower (9.6/10).
- **The Tokyo Edition, Ginza** — Known for its rooftop oasis (9.6/10).

1 Hotel Tokyo, a lifestyle hotel brand from the United States, opened in spring 2026, marking its first appearance in Japan. Located on floors 38-43 of the Akasaka Trust Building, it features 211 guest rooms, a restaurant, a café, a fitness center, a spa, a swimming pool, and meeting rooms.

**Pricing note:** Rates vary widely by season and property. For reference, entry-level 5-star rooms can start around $280–$360/night (Imperial, Prince Park Tower), while top-tier properties like the Palace Hotel can exceed $950/night.

## Iconic Luxury Palaces

**Hassler Roma** — A legendary luxury five-star hotel in Rome's city center located at the top of the Spanish Steps, it is the residence of choice for a memorable experience in the Eternal City. For nearly a decade, the Michelin-starred restaurant Imàgo has reigned on the Hassler's sixth floor with its spectacular panoramic view and Italian-fusion cuisine.

**Rome Cavalieri, A Waldorf Astoria Hotel** — Set in a private 15-acre Mediterranean park on Rome's highest hilltop, it offers sweeping panoramic views of the Eternal City with St. Peter's Dome in full view.

**Hotel Splendide Royal** — A luxury five-star hotel in the heart of the Eternal City, set in a 19th-century palace once the seat of the Roman Maronite community. Its restaurant, Mirabelle, directed by chef Bruno Borghesi, is regarded as one of the best in the city.

**Corinthia Rome** — A brand new hotel where contemporary luxury, historic grandeur, and personalized service come together in the heart of the Eternal City.

**Grand Hotel de la Minerve** — Set in a 17th-century palace in the quiet embrace of the Piazza della Minerva, this six-story hotel is housed in a restored late-17th century building with Napoleonic décor.

## Boutique & Design Hotels

**J.K. Place Roma** — Located in the very city center a stone's throw away from the Spanish Steps, featuring sumptuous rooms and indulgence suites, where every room has a separate living room, spacious marble bathrooms, and a canopy bed.

**Umiltà 36** — A gem in the heart of Rome, consistently earning near-perfect customer ratings for its exceptional staff, location, and interiors. The hotel masterfully blends modern luxury with art-focused decor, situated just a five-minute stroll from Piazza Venezia and other iconic landmarks like the Trevi Fountain.

**Hotel Lord Byron** — One of those small luxury hotels that attracts fierce loyalty, a haven of tasteful elegance with a 1920s vibe near leafy Villa Borghese; the upside of its off-centre location is peace, quiet and the sense of having wandered into the private Roman residence of a wealthy collector.

## Other Notable Options
Additional highly-rated 5-star properties include The St. Regis Rome, The Westin Excelsior, Sofitel Roma Villa Borghese, Anantara Palazzo Naiadi Rome Hotel, Villa Agrippina Gran Meliá, and Parco dei Principi Grand Hotel & SPA.

## Pricing
Rates for five-star hotels in Rome can vary significantly based on location, season, and level of luxury. Prices generally start around 350 to 450 Euros per night and can climb up to 1,000 Euros or more.
